note: XXVII cue 97: the mark leaves Mina in smoke — Google edit on Midjourney Q2-1 (Ian: smoke must rise from the scar)

beats.text: Remove the column of smoke on the left of the picture entirely. Make the mark on the young woman's forehead a single clear upright cross, small, dark red, exactly in the centre of her forehead just above the brows. From that cross, and only from it, a thin wisp of dense white smoke rises straight upward from her forehead and curls away into the sunset sky above her head. No smoke anywhere near her mouth. Keep her face, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.
